description: Look up Monster Hunter: World game data from mhw-db.com, a free community database: monsters with their weaknesses, resistances and the ailments they inflict, weapons and their upgrade trees, armor pieces and sets, charms, decorations, skills, items, ailments, locations, attack motion values and past event quests. It covers the base game in full and Iceborne in part (master rank armor and a few of its monsters, but no Iceborne weapons), and is no longer updated. No account or API key required.
